movies.Title: Pillion
movies.Actors: Harry Melling, Alexander Skarsgård, Douglas Hodge
movies.Plot: A directionless man is swept off his feet when an enigmatic, impossibly handsome biker takes him on as his submissive.
movies.PlotES: Un hombre sin rumbo se enamora perdidamente de un enigmático y guapísimo motorista que lo toma como su sumiso.

movies.Title: Hoje Eu Quero Voltar Sozinho
movies.Actors: Ghilherme Lobo, Fabio Audi, Tess Amorim
movies.Plot: Leonardo is a blind teenager searching for independence. His everyday life, the relationship with his best friend Giovana, and the way he sees the world change completely with the arrival of Gabriel.
movies.PlotES: Leonardo es un adolescente ciego que busca independencia. Su vida cotidiana, la relación con su mejor amiga Giovana y la forma en que ve el mundo cambian por completo con la llegada de Gabriel.

movies.Title: Mariposas Verdes
movies.Writer: Katalina Boham, Gustavo Nieto Roa, Mauricio Pichardo
movies.Actors: Deivi Duarte, Kevin Bury, Cecilia Suárez
movies.Plot: Mateo an intelligent and popular school-boy falls in love with Daniel, but when that relationship is made public, Mateo is at a crossroads, and will have to decide between fighting his adversaries, or giving up everything.
movies.PlotES: Mateo, un inteligente y popular estudiante, se enamora de Daniel, pero cuando esa relación se hace pública, Mateo se encuentra en una encrucijada y tendrá que decidir entre luchar contra sus adversarios o renunciar a todo.

movies.Title: Sueño en Otro Idioma
movies.Actors: Fernando Álvarez Rebeil, José Manuel Poncelis, Eligio Meléndez
movies.Plot: When a language dies, a unique vision of the world is lost forever.
movies.PlotES: Cuando un idioma muere, una visión única del mundo se pierde para siempre.
